children: ) (FSE: UI8) (the "Company") announces that it has scheduled its next Annual General Meeting of Shareholders for December 16, 2026 at 9:00 am EDT in Montreal and announces that Michael Moore, a member of its Board of Directors, has resigned. Michael served on a few Board committees and will be missed by the Strategic Resources management team.

) is a critical mineral development company focused on vanadium, high-purity iron and titanium; metals needed to decarbonize the global economy. Our main projects are the construction-ready BlackRock Project in Quebec and the previously operated Mustavaara Mine in Finland. Phase 1 of the BlackRock Project envisages a 4 million tonne per year high-purity iron ore pelletizer at Port Saguenay, Quebec with full access to the St. Lawrence Seaway. The Company's Head Office is in Montreal, Québec.
